Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

catlasr 0.0.1

First pre-release, tagged v0.0.1 before data collection of fba-allergy-online-02, the pre-registered replication of three-stage forward blocking (Beesley & Le Pelley, 2011). The pre-registration names this version and its preprocessing functions, which are frozen from this tag on. The pre-release contains no data.

Freeze policy

The preprocessing layer is frozen at v0.0.1 (#32). It covers every exported function that imports, validates, excludes or scores data:

  • import: pull_jatos_batches(), parse_jatos_results(), repair_jatos_json();
  • data bundles: build_provenance(), build_fba_rawdata(), validate_fba_rawdata(), record_exclusion(), provenance(), extract_meta(), extract_stimuli(), extract_trials(), fba_cues_map();
  • personal data: update_id_key(), write_debrief_coding(), read_debrief_coding(), write_private_rds(), write_private_csv(), read_private_rds();
  • learning check: score_learning(), test_learning(), screen_learning(), aggregate_learning();
  • blocking indices: score_blocking(), index_blocking(), aggregate_blocking().

The plotting functions, trace_progress() and the stimulus functions do not change any reported number and stay outside the freeze.

The exported surface of this version, every exported function and S3 method with its arguments and defaults, is recorded in inst/api/v0.0.1.txt. From this tag on:

  • every change to a frozen function gets an entry in this file stating whether it affects the registered analysis of fba-allergy-online-02;
  • any change that can alter a reported number, including a bug fix, is a deviation from the registered analysis and is labelled as such here.

Contents

  • Import from JATOS.
    pull_jatos_batches() downloads the results of one or more batches. It reads the complete jsPsych data from the result file when the experiment uploaded one (result_file), falls back on the streamed data otherwise, records the source of every study result in data_source and reports the trials the file recovered (#38). parse_jatos_results() and repair_jatos_json() turn the results into trial tables.

  • Data bundles and provenance.
    build_provenance() records where the data come from (#26); build_fba_rawdata() builds and validate_fba_rawdata() validates a forward-blocking bundle of participant metadata, stimulus mappings and trials, checking the trials against the design registry and aborting on imbalanced complete runs. Bundles refuse identifying and free-text columns; sex and age are optional, so that shared data sets can leave them out.

  • Exclusions.
    record_exclusion() removes participants and records the exclusion rule, its description and the participants it removed in the provenance. A provenance can also carry deferred exclusions, each naming the analysis set it leads to, so that a shared data set can hold just one sample from which all analysis sets are derived. print(provenance(x)) lists the rules by name and count; exclusions = "long" adds their descriptions.

  • Learning check.
    score_learning(), test_learning() (one-sided exact binomial test against chance, alpha = 0.1), screen_learning(), aggregate_learning() and plot_learning().

  • Blocking indices.
    score_blocking() scores the test stage, dropping the confidence rating of timed-out test trials; index_blocking() computes the confidence-weighted choice score of Beesley and Le Pelley (2011) and the choice-proportion score of Paskewitz and Jones (2020) (#34); aggregate_blocking() and plot_blocking().

  • Personal data.
    write_private_rds(), write_private_csv() and read_private_rds() keep personal data in a private folder outside every repository (#16), with one subfolder per study and a guard against subfolders that link elsewhere. update_id_key() replaces platform identifiers with random six-digit participant IDs, keeping the key in the private folder. write_debrief_coding() and read_debrief_coding() code the free-text debriefing answers blind to the test data (#40).

  • Monitoring.
    trace_progress() reports how far every participant got, without reading any test response.

  • Stimuli.
    catlas_stimulus(), render_stimulus() and write_stimulus() compose the cue and outcome images of the allergist task.

  • Data scripts.
    data-raw/ holds the import of fba-allergy-online-02, which builds the shared data set fba_allergy_online_02 (the Full sample, with the learning and prior-knowledge rules deferred; #39), and the e-mail exports of both studies. They are not part of the installed package.
